name: Belo Betty
title: Pump up your allies for an all-out assault with the Revolutionary Army!
desc:
This aggro deck uses its buffing effect to grant allies an incredible total of up to 9000 power.

Many Revolutionary Army Characters can activate effects when their power increases, allowing for explosive turns.

cards.name: Belo Betty
cards.text: [Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] You may trash 1 {Revolutionary Army} type card from your hand: Up to 3 of your {Revolutionary Army} type Characters or Characters with a [Trigger] gain +3000 power during this turn.

cards.name: Otama
cards.text: [On Play] Give up to 1 of your opponent's Characters −2000 power during this turn.

cards.name: Belo Betty
cards.text: [On Play] Look at 5 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 {Revolutionary Army} type card other than [Belo Betty] and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.

cards.name: Koala
cards.text: [On Play] If your Leader has the {Revolutionary Army} type, give up to 1 of your opponent's Characters −3000 power during this turn.

cards.name: Bunny Joe
cards.text: [Blocker] (After your opponent declares an attack, you may rest this card to make it the new target of the attack.)

cards.name: Inazuma
cards.text:
If you have a Character with 7000 power or more other than this Character, this Character gains [Rush].
(This card can attack on the turn in which it is played.)

cards.name: Morley
cards.text: [When Attacking] If this Character has 7000 power or more, your opponent cannot activate [Blocker] during this battle.
cards.trigger: [Trigger] You may trash 1 card from your hand: If your Leader is multicolored, play this card.

cards.name: Emporio.Ivankov
cards.text: [Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] If this Character has 7000 power or more, play up to 1 {Revolutionary Army} type Character card with 5000 power or less other than [Emporio.Ivankov] from your hand.

cards.name: Karasu
cards.text:
[On Play] If your Leader has the {Revolutionary Army} type, give up to 1 of your opponent's Leader or Character cards −1000 power during this turn.
[When Attacking] If this Character has 7000 power or more, give up to 1 of your opponent's Leader or Character cards −1000 power during this turn.

cards.name: Lindbergh
cards.text: [When Attacking] If this Character has 7000 power or more, K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with 3000 power or less.
cards.trigger: [Trigger] You may trash 1 card from your hand: If your Leader is multicolored, play this card.

cards.name: Gedatsu
cards.text: [On Play] K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost equal to or less than the number of your opponent's Life cards.

cards.name: Satori
cards.trigger: [Trigger] You may trash 1 card from your hand: Play this card.

cards.name: Charlotte Linlin
cards.text:
[On Play] Your opponent chooses one:
- Trash 1 card from the top of your opponent's Life cards.
- Add 1 card from the top of your deck to the top of your Life cards.

cards.name: Four Thousand-Brick Fist
cards.text: [Main] Up to 1 of your Leader or Character cards gains +2000 power during this turn. Then, K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with 2000 power or less.
cards.trigger: [Trigger] Up to 1 of your Leader or Character cards gains +1000 power during this turn.

cards.name: Emporio Energy Hormone
cards.text: [Counter] Up to 1 of your Leader or Character cards gains +3000 power during this battle. Then, play up to 1 {Revolutionary Army} type Character card with 5000 power or less from your hand.
cards.trigger: [Trigger] Play up to 1 {Revolutionary Army} type Character card with 5000 power or less from your hand.
